===FCC=== Per FCC test report {{FCC.io|PY313200233}} (w/ ''Manual Tool v2.0.1.0'' as the utility), the device seems to be… * [[Broadcom]]-based, and supported by a {{#ask:[[WI1 chip1 model::BCM4360]] OR [[WI2 chip1 model::BCM4360]]|limit=0|mainlabel=Device|searchlabel=BCM4360}}-powered WLAN AC card.
*Netgear requested FCC re-certification for the R7000 on December 17, 2018 under {{FCC.io|PY318300420}} :due to an internal redesign, likely as part of a drive to cut manufacturing costs. :Some minor components (RAM, FEM, etc.) may have changed, but the same chips are still used. <!--{{FCC ST|06/16/2019}}-->
=== Wi-Fi Alliance === Netgear sought evaluation for two variants of the device shortly after launch and both received :the Certified classification on March 7, 2014. * {{WiFiCert|WFA53679|03/05/2014|9323}} * {{WiFiCert|WFA53679|03/06/2014|20466}}
===Reviews=== * [https://www.smallnetbuilder.com/wireless/wireless-news/netgear-joins-the-ac1900-club/ ''Netgear Joins The AC1900 Club'' on '''SmallNetBuilder'''] : [[Broadcom]] BCM4709A0 (''BCM4709A0KFEBG'') and a pair of BCM4360 :* There is a single USB 3.0 port on the front of the unit and another (only USB 2.0) in the rear. :* This device seems to be functionally equivalent (or quite similar) to the [[ASUS RT-AC68U]]. * [https://www.smallnetbuilder.com/wireless/wireless-reviews/ac1900-first-look-netgear-r7000-a-asus-rt-ac68u/ ''First Look: NETGEAR R7000 & ASUS RT-AC68U'' on '''SmallNetBuilder'''] ** "U12H270T00", "801466" and "REV.1 GP" are silk-screened on the board. ** The device is using the [[Broadcom]] BCM4709A SoC + BCM4360×2 ::3× [[Skyworks]] (''SiGe'') SE2623L PAMs for the 2.4GHz radio ::3× [[Skyworks]] (''SiGe'') SE5003L1 PAMs for the 5GHz radio * [https://www.cnet.com/reviews/netgear-nighthawk-ac1900-smart-wi-fi-router-r7000-review/ ''Netgear Nighthawk AC1900 Smart Wi-Fi Router (R7000)'' on '''CNET'''] : 04:A1:51 OUI and ''NETGEARXX'' SSID, states this device uses BCM4709. * [https://www.pcworld.com/article/447895/netgear-nighthawk-review-this-802-11ac-router-sets-lan-speed-records.html ''Netgear NightHawk AC1900 Smart R7000 Router'' on '''PCWorld'''] * [https://web.archive.org/web/20171224104525if_/https://lookgadgets.com/10-best-wireless-routers/#2_NetGear_NightHawk_AC1900_8211_R7000_Fastest_overall_throughput_and_slick_design ''Netgear NightHawk AC1900 R7000 Router'' on '''LookGadgets''']
